newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' SEC okays Seafront new shares.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' SEC okays Seafront new shares.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved an application of Seafront Resources Corp to register 30 billion new shares with a par value of one centavo each, documents released by the SEC on Monday showed.
The new shares will represent an increase in Seafront's authorised capital stock to 800 million pesos from the previous 500 million pesos.
Out of the 30 billion shares, 7.5 billion shares will be issued to cover the 15 percent stock dividend declared by the board last year.
Seafront is a holding company for subsidiaries engaged mainly in oil exploration.
